routes.name: Eswatini Visa (tourist, business, volunteer, intern)
routes.summary: Nationalities on the visa-required list need a visa before travel for stays up to one month. Visa on arrival is meant to be suspended, so get it first. Other nationalities don't need one.

other: Only nationalities on Eswatini's visa-required list need one
Return or onward ticket for air travelers
Entry is decided by the immigration officer at the border

stay.note: Visas cover stays up to one month. Longer stays, work or study need a Temporary Residence Permit.

steps: Check if your nationality needs a visa
Apply at the Ministry of Home Affairs HQ, an Eswatini mission, or online at evisa.gov.sz
Get the visa in your passport before you travel
documents: Passport with at least 2 unused pages

routes.name: Transit through Eswatini
routes.summary: If you are transiting, say so in your visa application and give a clear reason. Otherwise you can be sent back to where you came from.

other: Only for nationalities that need a visa

routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit
routes.summary: Needed for work, study, immigration or any stay over 30 days. Specific permit types, fees and rules were not confirmed on the pages read.

other: Permit rules differ from visa rules. Check with the Ministry of Home Affairs for permit types, fees and documents.
